description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {2}, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {2}.
When Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead activate Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.
